profile_text.body:
Zoom is a publicly traded communications company (ticker: ZM, CIK: 0001585521) founded in 2011 and headquartered in San Jose, California. Its website describes the company as offering a unified collaboration platform that includes video meetings, Zoom Chat, VoIP phone, webinars, whiteboard, contact center, and events tools, positioned around modernizing workplace workflows.

On the AI side, Zoom offers a product called Zoom AI Companion, which the site describes as built-in AI that summarizes meetings, automates next steps, and can generate assets such as presentations and documents. The site also references a feature called ZoomMate in connection with this asset-generation capability. Recording consent is noted as relevant to how the meeting summarization feature operates.

The held facts indicate Zoom has a notable legal footprint, with 174 cases associated with California exposure recorded in the site's litigation data. No MCP server registrations or SEC patent filings beyond the company's standard public-company profile are present in the current data.
